reason: The README clearly describes a memory and context plugin that uses an LLM to manage persistent cross-session memories, retrieve relevant items, and inject them into requests.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的语言模型分析对话、持久化和检索记忆，并在请求前将相关记忆注入上下文。
summaries.en: Uses a configured language model to analyze conversations, persist and retrieve memories, and inject relevant memories into request context.

capabilities: Analyzes conversation turns with a configured LLM to select memories
Persists memories in a local JSON file
Retrieves relevant memories before requests and injects them into model context
Deduplicates memories and removes memories below a configured importance threshold
